intro: We hold a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹{{budget}} lakh for {{count}} published BBA / BBM / BBS colleges in India. This list is for students looking at the best BBA / BBM / BBS colleges under ₹1 lakh.
Ranked colleges that fit the budget come first, then the rest are ordered by recorded total fee, lowest first. A low figure can be one-year tuition, so read the programme name on the card.
listLead: The first cards include Deen Dayal Upadhyaya College in Delhi, MS Ramaiah College in Bangalore, and the College of Vocational Studies, also in Delhi. The last of those shows a recorded BMS fee of ₹10,000, which should be checked on the official notice.
snapshot: Across the {{feeN}} published colleges here, the median recorded fee is {{feeMedian}}. The middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
Most listings are private ({{private}}), with {{public}} public institutes. Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Haryana, Karnataka and Delhi NCR have the most colleges on this budget list.
Use the list of top BBA / BBM / BBS colleges in India 2026 as a shortlist, then confirm the official fee notice and the admission test.
firstCollegesLead: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya College, a University of Delhi campus, is listed first, with a recorded BMS fee of ₹20,430 and a 2022 average package of ₹4 lakh. Delhi University undergraduate business seats are filled through CUET (UG) 2026, as the official bulletin sets out.
Uttarakhand Open University also appears early, which is an open university rather than a regular campus. Confirm the teaching model and whether a low fee is for one year or the full programme.

compare.heading: How to compare the best BBA / BBM / BBS colleges under ₹1 lakh
paragraphs: Start with the award and the fee notice, because a BMS, a BBA and an integrated programme are not priced the same way.
Then check these points on the official site:
bullets: Whether the fee is for one year or the full programme, and whether university or exam charges are included.
Whether the college is a regular campus or an open or distance programme.
The entrance route for 2026, including CUET UG for Delhi University colleges.
The latest official placement report for that undergraduate programme, treated as a historical record rather than a promise.

faqs.question: How many BBA colleges here have a fee under ₹1 lakh?
faqs.answer: {{count}} published BBA / BBM / BBS colleges in our records have a main-programme fee of up to ₹{{budget}} lakh, and colleges without a recorded fee do not appear on this budget list.

faqs.question: What is the typical fee on this under-₹1-lakh list?
faqs.answer: Among the {{feeN}} published colleges here, the median recorded fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.

faqs.question: Is a ₹10,000 fee the cheapest full BBA programme?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily, because ₹10,000 is only the lowest figure we treat as quotable, and it may be one-year tuition, so confirm the official notice before you budget.

faqs.question: How do Delhi University BMS admissions work in 2026?
faqs.answer: The University of Delhi bulletin says undergraduate business seats are filled through CUET (UG) 2026. Confirm the required subjects in the official bulletin.

faqs.question: Why is an open university on this list?
faqs.answer: Uttarakhand Open University has a recorded BBA fee under ₹1 lakh in our file, but the teaching model is not the same as a regular campus, so read the official prospectus.

sources.label: University of Delhi, Bulletin of Information for undergraduate admissions 2026–27
